catholic-encyclopedia-1913-pope-john-xix: This entry untangles the numbering muddle of Johns XIX and XX, explaining how a medieval error skipped a number. A specialized study of papal chronology as the 1913 editors recorded it, untangling the confused medieval lists at very long last.
catholic-encyclopedia-1913-pope-john-xxi: John XXI was the Portuguese physician-pope, Peter of Spain, killed by a falling ceiling. This entry traces his pontificate, his learning, and his strange death. The doctor on Peter's throne: his new ceiling crushed him at Viterbo in 1277's spring.
